blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman turned witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday that the remaining “maleta boys” were allegedly offered P10 million each to recant their statements. Christopher Esquivel made the revelation while testifying at the plunder bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, who is accused of receiving P7.44 billion in kickbacks purportedly delivered by the maleta boys, who are former security personnel of former Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co. Romualdez has denied any wrongdoing. READ: Witness to Sandiganbayan: Cash delivered in 4 areas for Romualdez Esquivel was a former security personnel of Co, who is […]...
